question: What are the available versions for software 'requests'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:SoftwareVersion) RETURN v.versionName AS version ORDER BY version

question: Does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' have any known vulnerabilities?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(c:Vulnerability) RETURN count(c) > 0 AS has_vuln

question: Does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' exist in the graph?
What are the direct dependencies of software 'requests' version '2.31.0'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dep:SoftwareVersion) OPTIONAL MATCH (ds:Software)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(dep) RETURN DISTINCT ds.name AS software, dep.versionName AS version ORDER BY software, version

question: Does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' directly depend on software 'idna'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dep:SoftwareVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(ds:Software {name: 'idna'}) RETURN count(dep) > 0 AS depends

question: What are the CVE IDs of known vulnerabilities affecting software 'requests' version '2.31.0'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(c:Vulnerability) RETURN DISTINCT c.cveId AS cveId ORDER BY cveId

question: What CWE IDs are associated with vulnerabilities of software 'requests' version '2.31.0'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(:Vulnerability)-[:VULNERABILITY_TYPE]->(w:VulnerabilityType) RETURN DISTINCT w.cweId AS cweId ORDER BY cweId

question: What are all transitive dependencies of software 'requests' version '2.31.0'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(dep:SoftwareVersion) OPTIONAL MATCH (ds:Software)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(dep) RETURN DISTINCT ds.name AS software, dep.versionName AS version ORDER BY software, version

question: Does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' depend on software 'idna' at any depth?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(dep:SoftwareVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(ds:Software {name: 'idna'}) RETURN count(dep) > 0 AS depends

question: What dependency path exists from software 'requests' version '2.31.0' to software 'idna'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (ds:Software {name: 'idna'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(target:SoftwareVersion) MATCH p = shortestPath((root)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(target)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.versionName] AS path

question: How many direct dependencies does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' have?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dep:SoftwareVersion) RETURN count(DISTINCT dep) AS cnt

question: How many total transitive dependencies does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' have?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(dep:SoftwareVersion) RETURN count(DISTINCT dep) AS cnt

question: How many vulnerabilities (CVEs) does software 'requests' version '2.31.0' have?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(c:Vulnerability) RETURN count(c) AS cnt

question: How many distinct CWE types affect software 'requests' version '2.31.0'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(root:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (root)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(:Vulnerability)-[:VULNERABILITY_TYPE]->(w:VulnerabilityType) RETURN count(DISTINCT w) AS cnt

question: What common direct dependencies are shared by software 'requests' version '2.31.0' and software 'django' version '4.2.11'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s1:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r1:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) MATCH (s2:Software {name: 'django'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r2:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '4.2.11'}) MATCH (r1)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d:SoftwareVersion)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(r2) OPTIONAL MATCH (ds:Software)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(d) RETURN DISTINCT ds.name AS software, d.versionName AS version ORDER BY software, version

question: Which has more direct dependencies: software 'requests' version '2.31.0' or software 'django' version '4.2.11'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s1:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r1:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r1)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d1:SoftwareVersion) WITH count(DISTINCT d1) AS c1 MATCH (s2:Software {name: 'django'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r2:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '4.2.11'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r2)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d2:SoftwareVersion) WITH c1, count(DISTINCT d2) AS c2 RETURN c1, c2

question: Which has more known vulnerabilities (CVEs): software 'requests' version '2.31.0' or software 'django' version '4.2.11'?
cypher_query: MATCH (s1:Software {name: 'requests'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r1:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '2.31.0'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r1)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(cve1:Vulnerability) WITH count(cve1) AS n1 MATCH (s2:Software {name: 'django'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(r2:SoftwareVersion {versionName: '4.2.11'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r2)-[:VULNERABLE_TO]->(cve2:Vulnerability) WITH n1, count(cve2) AS n2 RETURN n1, n2
